BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

Corporate Drinkware Gifts: Choose by Recipient and Distribution

Plan a usable branded item around the recipient, beverage and distribution requirements, then review the sample and packing.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Define the recipient’s task

A personal tumbler, folding cup and bottle-opening kit solve different tasks. Select the format before adding a logo; a logo alone does not make a shared service item an individual gift.

Compare practical configuration

Review grip, required capacity, lid or straw components, carrying and cleaning. PJB-036 is factory-confirmed without a handle; choose it on that basis rather than describing it as a handled tumbler.

Approve artwork and the unboxing plan

Agree decoration area, colour references, sample and exact kit contents. Request separate model and design quantities; do not invent retention, sustainability or campaign-return claims without evidence.

Before Sending the Enquiry

Review itemWhat to send
Model & portionSKU, vessel shape and required capacity option.
Use & configurationBeverage, temperature conditions, lid, straw or other components.
Artwork & deliveryDesign quantities, decoration position, packing, destination and arrival date.
